subtitle: Breaded cod fish fingers with chips and garden peas, suited to children who prefer mild flavours and familiar textures.
quickAnswer: Wetherspoons kids fish fingers cost a typical {price}, list {calories} kcal and come with chips, garden peas, a children’s drink and a fresh piece of fruit. The plate includes three thick breaded cod fish fingers with a crisp coating and soft, flaky fish inside. Prices vary by pub.

taste:
The fish fingers have a crisp breaded exterior around soft, flaky cod. Their mild white-fish flavour makes this a straightforward introduction to seafood, particularly for children who prefer familiar food without challenging flavours. Three thick fingers form the centre of the plate, with the contrast between coating and fish providing the main textural interest.

Golden chips and sweet garden peas keep the accompaniments simple. The peas bring colour and sweetness alongside the fish, while the chips make the combination recognisably a childhood classic. A children’s drink comes with the meal, and a fresh piece of fruit follows as dessert rather than another breaded or chip-based element.
value:
The included children’s drink and fresh fruit make the typical {price} worth considering as a complete meal rather than just a main plate. Prices vary by pub, and it is {pricePosition}.

Compare it with Kids Chicken Nuggets if your child prefers chicken, or Kids Sausages and Mash if that sounds more appealing. Kids Margherita Pizza is a listed vegetarian alternative. The practical value depends on how much of the fish, chips and peas your child is likely to eat, so preference matters alongside the price.
nutrition:
The listed energy figure is {calories} kcal, equivalent to {calorieShare}. Within the tracked {category} selection, it is {caloriePosition}. Use those comparisons as context, rather than as a target for an individual child.

Check which included elements the figure covers, particularly the children’s drink and fruit. Changing sides, choosing a different drink or adding sauces can change the total, so ask the pub for the information relevant to your order. Extra desserts should also be considered separately.
dietaryGuidance:
This cod-based meal is not suitable for vegetarian or vegan diners, and our data gives it no dietary tags. The listed allergens are cereals containing gluten, eggs and fish. Children who need to avoid any of these should have the current [allergen information](/allergen-information) checked before ordering.

Ask the pub about the complete meal, including the drink and fruit, rather than checking only the fish fingers. Any agreed swaps can change the allergen profile. Kids Margherita Pizza is tagged vegetarian, while Kids Tomato Pasta and Kids Vegan Sausages are tagged vegan and vegetarian.
